status: First additive exterior layout completed; not a finished environment.

preservation.rollback: Open the preserved source, or exclude EXT_Expansion01 and use the original camera in the new file.
preservation.note: New geometry can change silhouettes, shadows and reflections even though all original scene data remains unchanged.

additions: Three closed exterior houses on the opposite bank.
Applied rear window and door panels on the original shops; no openings cut.
Rear lane and side connections around the original shop row.
A timber return footbridge linking both banks into a loop.
Low boundary walls and access gates defining a limited exterior area.

visual_review.purpose: Overview of the two banks, return bridge and exterior layout.
visual_review.observed: Both-bank loop and added opposite houses are visible. New houses remain simplified and darker than the original storefronts. A conspicuous blue strip remains outside the left local boundary.

visual_review.purpose: Reverse view of the original shop backs and new rear lane.
visual_review.observed: Rear wall details and rear circulation space are present. Dark stretched ground planes and abrupt distant edges are exposed from this angle; background completion is still required.

navigation.limitation: Centerline floor and body-ray diagnostics are not full collision or navigability certification. Existing paving joints require step handling or a future collision proxy.

limits: Unseen areas are inferred design additions, not recovered facts from the single reference image.
All buildings remain exterior-only; doors are closed and interiors are not enterable.
Original lighting was preserved, leaving rear areas and new houses dark.
Distant terrain and water edges outside the bounded area remain unfinished.
New-house detailing is intentionally lower than the original storefronts.
The website and its existing 3D scene were not updated.
recommended_next_step: Review and approve the exterior layout first. Then address exposed boundaries and ground-level collision continuity additively before increasing prop density or adding interiors.
